answers.goal: Keeps the end-to-end score as the release gate, adds a labelled check per step, labels the first failing step on the failed cases, scores a step on frozen upstream outputs, and compares old and new extraction on the same cases before any swap.

Refuses the judge as a gate below 80% agreement, revises the rubric by splitting vague criteria and adding pass and fail examples, keeps human review until it passes, and writes the plan with per-class thresholds and a baseline that names the judge model and date.
